note: BH-8329: settings row lib.slice-closeout.slice_closeout_exclude_headings. A |-separated list of exclusion labels, matched case-insensitively. A coverage-matrix row, a sub-heading or a plan heading whose text IS one of them, or starts with one followed by `:`, `(` or a dash, is not remaining work: it never becomes a Rest-of child or a slice child. `none` turns exclusion off; empty uses the default.
